notes.title: Animal Simulator was released today!
notes.content:
Today's edition brings a lot of news. New locations, animals and environments with dinosaurs!

[b]NEW ANIMALS[/b]
We have added a bear to the forest fauna. This powerful animal can be used for attacks, but also for transport. 
We have added the Forest Golem and the Beast to the fantasy fauna. Both monsters are strong and can be transported through.


[b]DINOSAURS[/b]
A brand new dinousaur pack has been added. You can use the new locations where the surrounding fauna consists of dinosaurs. You can hunt them or just watch them live their own life. There are more than 30 species of dinosaurs in the game, ranging from herbivores, carnivores, pterosaurs and paribas.
[b]
NEW LOCATIONS[/b]
In conjunction with the new dinosaur pack, we've added 3 new locations where you can enjoy these creatures.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
We have made a large number of bug fixes, adjustments and optimizations.

We hope you enjoy Animal SImulator!

notes.title: The full Animal Simulator game is coming soon
notes.content:
The release of the full Animal Simulator game is approaching. Many new features await you.

- Redesigned graphics
- New animals
- lots of minor fixes and adjustments

notes.title: New patch released
notes.content:
The new patch brings several changes and modifications. The main ones are optimization of the game itself, location loading and memory usage.


The patch also brings many minor fixes, adjustments and optimizations.

notes.title: New patch 2.3 - fantasy animals are coming!
notes.content:
The fantasy world is coming to the game! Control animals with special abilities. Patch brings a brand new transport option and lots of other new features.

[b]DRAGON[/b]
Here comes the ultimate predator dragon that knows no competition in the animal world. At the same time, you can fly it or help you with wood.

- the possibility to fly on a dragon
- The dragon can use fire or claws to hunt
- the ability to transport wood with the dragon
- the possibility of unique dragon/wolf combinations

[b]PEGAS[/b]
The mythical Pegasus resembles a classic horse, except that it has wings and the ability to fly.

- The ability to fly on a pegasus
- the possibility of a unique Pegasus/horse combination

The new patch also brings a lot of fixes and improvements.

notes.content:

An overview of the news you can look forward to in the near future:

1) another new patch and game optimization
2) several new maps for the base game
3) New DLC set in the Middle Ages
4) New fantasy animals - dragon, pegasus, forest golem

We are also preparing more content with forest animals - bear, deer etc...

notes.title: The first Alpha version of our game is coming out!
notes.content:
We have good news for all animal lovers! The release of the public ALFA version of our game is slowly approaching! The final work and basic tuning of the game are currently underway.

[b]At the start of the game you can look forward to the following:[/b]
- two packs of animals. You can choose from classic or African fauna
- 10 singleplayer locations
- 2 urban locations (village, town), 8 natural locations.
 
[b]Local multiplayer[/b]
- You can play on a shared screen with a friend
- two modes - 2x animal or 2xanimal + human

[b]Finished parts for animals[/b]
- Basic missions and events. Depending on the type of animal, you can hunt or look for crops.
- getting a partner in a pack and group hunting, catering
- the possibility of unlimited travel between locations
- Possibility to drive your human friend


At the same time, at the start, the built-in function will allow you to play as a human helper, if you wish.

[b]Human helper animal - ready functions [/b]
- the ability to mine raw materials (stone, wood) and sell them
- construction, cultivation of basic crops and animal behavior
- the possibility of family and hiring workers
- various types of vehicles (transport, commercial, etc.)
- basic trade and transport of raw materials


Why did we build humans into the game? Because we think that some human-animal interactions can be fun and complementary. He can also play with the animal completely independently, without the help of a human.



We still have a lot of work to do. But the work is so advanced that the release of Alfa's game in Early Access is very close. We would like to give you an early opportunity to participate in creating our game.
